questions.q: Consider the dataset 10, 27, 32, 15 and 22. A new dataset is obtained by subtracting 3 from every observation. Compute the value of ($70^{\text{th}}$ percentile of new dataset) − ($30^{\text{th}}$ percentile of the old dataset).
Which of the following statements is/are true?
options: Median can be measured for a categorical variable only if the variable is nominal.
Mode can not be defined for categorical data.
There can be more than one mode for a data.
The sum of relative frequencies of all the observations in a given data set is always equal to 1.

questions.q: Let $X$ represent the cancellation lead time (in hours) for hotel bookings, where $X$ follows an exponential distribution with mean of 30 hours. What is the value of $x$ such that $P(X \ge x) = 0.20$? (More than one option can be correct.)
Let $n$ and $r$ be integers such that $n \ge r \ge 1$. Which of the following option(s) is/are true?
options: The number of ways to select 3 students from a group of 5 is $^5C_3$.
The number of ways to distribute 3 distinct prizes among 10 students is $^{10}C_3$.

questions.q: The time $T$ (in hours) it takes to repair a device is uniformly distributed over the interval $[a, b]$. It is known that the probability that the repair takes more than 7 hours is equal to the probability that it takes less than 3 hours. Find the value of $a + b$.

A dataset contains four distinct values $a, b, c, d$, with total frequency equal to 200. The relative frequencies of $a$ and $d$ are 0.20 and 0.25 respectively and the frequency of $b$ is 40. What is the cumulative relative frequency of $c$ and $d$ together? Enter the answer correct to one decimal place.

Anjali and Ramesh are playing a game in which each independently executes one database query. The probability that a query is successfully resolved is 60%. The game has the following rules:

- If exactly one player resolves the query successfully, that player gets ₹120 and the other player gets ₹0.
- If both succeed or both fail, then each gets ₹60.

What is the expected amount Ramesh gets?
If two fair dice are thrown, what is the probability that the sum is either 4 or 9? Enter the answer correct to two decimal places.

Table Q.2 shows the preferred mode of project work (Solo or Group) among MBA students across two specializations: Marketing and Finance.

|  | Marketing | Finance |
|---|---|---|
| Solo Project | 18 | 12 |
| Group Project | 32 | 38 |

Given that a student is from finance, what is the probability that they prefer Group Project work? Enter the answer correct to two decimal places.

questions.q: Find the value of $p$ such that $P(X = 3) = 1.5 \times P(X = 2)$.

questions.context:
A warehouse monitors the number of defective items in randomly chosen boxes as part of its quality control process. Each box contains 50 items. Let $X$ represent the number of defective items in a randomly selected box, with the following distribution:

$$P(X = x) = \begin{cases} \dfrac{x+1}{10}, & x = 0, 1, 2, 3 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise.} \end{cases}$$
questions.q: What is the probability that a randomly selected box contains at most 1 defective item? Enter the answer correct to one decimal place.
